content.text:
They are not all failing for one reason—the startup banner grouped three separate problems:

- `codex_apps`: transient stale Codex/ChatGPT token. The credential cache refreshed three seconds after startup, and `codex_apps` initialized successfully at 01:02:05. I confirmed a live GitHub connector call now works. Restarting the current Codex session should clear the stale startup state.
- `lobu`: its separate MCP OAuth refresh token is invalid. This has been failing since July 27, not just today. Lobu rotates refresh tokens and expires them after 30 days, so this token was expired, revoked, or previously rotated. Reauthorize it:
  ```bash
  codex mcp logout lobu
  codex mcp login lobu
  ```
- `lobu-local`: nothing is serving that address. Tailscale and DNS are working, but there is no Tailscale Serve configuration, no listener on port `8443`, and `curl` gets connection failure. Start the intended local HTTPS/dev endpoint, or disable/remove `lobu-local` if you do not need it.

If general OpenAI 401s persist after restarting Codex, renew the main login:

```bash
codex logout
codex login
```

Codex documents the separate main-login and MCP-login flows in [Authentication](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/auth.md) and [MCP configuration](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp.md).
